content.title: First release set to 21 July 2026 for pilot growers
content.statement: The board set the first release for 21 July 2026, for the pilot growers only.
content.context: Paul asked when the other growers can start.
content.rationale: Julie explained that the team wants a month of real use with a small group before more growers depend on the app.
content.impacts: Other greenhouses join after the pilot review in September.

sources.excerpt: Decision: the board set the first release for 21 July 2026, for the pilot growers only.
Julie explained that the team wants a month of real use with a small group before more growers depend on the app.
Other greenhouses join after the pilot review in September.
